title: Watch the new hire that never clocks out
caption:
Coca-Cola is deploying Boston Dynamics Spot robots at factories worldwide.

After an ongoing deployment in Barcelona, Coca-Cola EP is scaling Spot globally.
Spot is already running in East Kilbride, Scotland, locating air leaks and automating condition monitoring rounds.
